Question: Synckit #8 is green at 599582ec (delta from your 5fbe16e3 review: one nolint line). The fix lives in the serve daemon, so activating it means restarting serve pid 34640 on the new binary (daemonkit Ensure via synckitd install, keeping reposync's manifest absent and its helper disabled). How far should I take it?
Options: Merge+release, hold install (Recommended) | Merge, release, and restart serve | Hold everything
